allow-empty-blocks.description: Whether the node is allowed to propose empty blocks.

api.port.description: Port serving the Maru JSON-RPC API.

defaults.description: Shared defaults reused by linea and fork-transition; currently provides the L2 endpoint.

defaults.l2-eth-endpoint.description: Fallback L2 endpoint reused by linea.l2-eth-api-endpoint and fork-transition.l2-eth-api-endpoint.

defaults.l2-eth-endpoint.endpoint.description: Engine API endpoint URL of the execution-layer node.

defaults.l2-eth-endpoint.jwt-secret-path.description: Optional path to the JWT secret file used for authenticated Engine API calls. Omit to disable JWT authentication.

defaults.l2-eth-endpoint.timeout.description: Overall timeout for a single request to this endpoint.

follower-engine-apis.description: Named map of follower execution-layer endpoints. Each entry maps a follower name to its engine API endpoint settings.

fork-transition.description: Protocol fork transition monitoring settings. Has defaults so the section may be omitted.

fork-transition.l2-eth-api-endpoint.description: Optional L2 endpoint used to observe the protocol fork transition. Falls back to defaults.l2-eth-endpoint when omitted.

fork-transition.l2-eth-api-endpoint.endp.description: Engine API endpoint URL of the execution-layer node.

fork-transition.l2-eth-api-endpoint.jwt-.description: Optional path to the JWT secret file used for authenticated Engine API calls. Omit to disable JWT authentication.

fork-transition.l2-eth-api-endpoint.time.description: Overall timeout for a single request to this endpoint.

fork-transition.protocol-transition-poll.description: Interval between polls for the protocol fork transition.

linea.description: Linea-specific settings (L1/L2 endpoints, contract address). Omit on non-Linea networks. l1-eth-api is a deprecated alias of l1-eth-api-endpoint; set one of the two. l2-eth-api-endpoint falls back to defaults.l2-eth-endpoint when omitted.

linea.contract-address.description: Address of the Linea rollup contract on L1 (20-byte hex).

linea.l1-eth-api.description: Legacy L1 endpoint; alias for l1-eth-api-endpoint kept for backwards compatibility. Deprecated, use l1-eth-api-endpoint.

linea.l1-eth-api-endpoint.description: L1 execution-layer API endpoint used to monitor the rollup contract.

linea.l1-eth-api-endpoint.endpoint.description: Engine API endpoint URL of the execution-layer node.

linea.l1-eth-api-endpoint.jwt-secret-pat.description: Optional path to the JWT secret file used for authenticated Engine API calls. Omit to disable JWT authentication.

linea.l1-eth-api-endpoint.timeout.description: Overall timeout for a single request to this endpoint.

linea.l1-eth-api.endpoint.description: Engine API endpoint URL of the execution-layer node.

linea.l1-eth-api.jwt-secret-path.description: Optional path to the JWT secret file used for authenticated Engine API calls. Omit to disable JWT authentication.

linea.l1-eth-api.timeout.description: Overall timeout for a single request to this endpoint.

linea.l1-highest-block-tag.description: L1 block tag treated as the highest finalized block (e.g. finalized, safe, latest).

linea.l1-polling-interval.description: Interval between L1 polls for rollup contract events.

linea.l2-eth-api-endpoint.description: L2 execution-layer API endpoint used to set the chain head via the Engine API. Falls back to defaults.l2-eth-endpoint when omitted.

linea.l2-eth-api-endpoint.endpoint.description: Engine API endpoint URL of the execution-layer node.

linea.l2-eth-api-endpoint.jwt-secret-pat.description: Optional path to the JWT secret file used for authenticated Engine API calls. Omit to disable JWT authentication.

linea.l2-eth-api-endpoint.timeout.description: Overall timeout for a single request to this endpoint.

observability.jvm-metrics-enabled.description: Whether JVM-level metrics are exposed in addition to application metrics.

observability.prometheus-metrics-enabled.description: Whether Prometheus metrics are exposed on the observability port.

p2p.description: P2P networking settings. Omit to disable P2P.

p2p.discovery.description: Discovery (node lookup) settings. Omit to disable discovery.

p2p.discovery.advertised-ip.description: IP address advertised to peers for discovery. Omit to use the listen IP address.

p2p.discovery.bootnodes.description: Bootnode addresses (enodes) used to bootstrap discovery.

p2p.discovery.refresh-interval.description: Interval between discovery table refresh cycles.

p2p.discovery.retry-timeout.description: Timeout before retrying a failed discovery request.

p2p.discovery.search-timeout.description: Timeout for a single discovery search run.

p2p.gossiping.description: Gossipsub parameters. Wraps Teku's GossipConfig per the Ethereum consensus p2p spec.

p2p.gossiping.consider-peers-as-direct.description: Whether all peers are scored as direct peers in gossip peer scoring (libp2p GossipPeerScoreParams.isDirect).

p2p.gossiping.d.description: Target mesh degree (number of peers each topic is gossiped to).

p2p.gossiping.d-high.description: Upper bound on the mesh degree; peers are pruned when the mesh exceeds this. Defaults to 2 * d.

p2p.gossiping.d-lazy.description: Degree of lazy (non-mesh) peers used for gossip amplification.

p2p.gossiping.d-low.description: Lower bound on the mesh degree; peers are added when the mesh drops below this.

p2p.gossiping.fanout-t-t-l.description: Time-to-live for gossip fanout messages sent to peers outside the mesh.

p2p.gossiping.flood-publish-max-message-.description: Maximum message size above which flood publishing is skipped. Defaults to 16KiB.

p2p.gossiping.gossip-factor.description: Fraction of non-mesh peers that receive gossip messages (libp2p gossipFactor).

p2p.gossiping.gossip-size.description: Number of history windows advertised via IHAVE messages (libp2p gossipSize).

p2p.gossiping.history.description: Number of gossip history windows retained in the message cache (libp2p gossipHistoryLength).

p2p.gossiping.seen-t-t-l.description: Time-to-live for the seen-message cache. Defaults to 700ms * 1115.

p2p.ip-address.description: IP address the node listens on for P2P traffic. Defaults to localhost for security.

p2p.max-peers.description: Maximum number of peers the node maintains.

p2p.max-unsynced-peers.description: Maximum number of out-of-sync peers tolerated before throttling sync from them. Reserved; not currently enforced by the node.

p2p.peering-fork-mismatch-leeway-time.description: Leeway time during which a peer is tolerated despite a fork mismatch before being penalized.

p2p.port.description: TCP port the node listens on for P2P traffic. UDP discovery uses p2p.discovery.port.

p2p.reconnect-delay.description: Delay before reconnecting to a dropped peer.

p2p.reputation.ban-period.description: Duration a peer is banned after dropping below the disconnect threshold.

p2p.reputation.capacity.description: Maximum number of peers tracked in the reputation table.

p2p.reputation.cooldown-period.description: Duration a peer's reputation is held before decaying after a change.

p2p.reputation.disconnect-score-threshol.description: Reputation score below which a peer is disconnected. Defaults to -large-change.

p2p.reputation.large-change.description: Reputation score delta applied for a large positive/negative event.

p2p.reputation.max-reputation.description: Maximum reputation score a peer can reach. Defaults to 2 * large-change.

p2p.reputation.small-change.description: Reputation score delta applied for a small positive/negative event.

p2p.static-peers.description: Static peer addresses (enodes) the node stays connected to.

p2p.status-update.refresh-interval-leewa.description: Leeway applied to the peer status refresh interval.

p2p.status-update.timeout.description: Timeout for a single peer status update request.

payload-validator.description: Validator execution-layer node settings. Required when qbft is set.

payload-validator.engine-api-endpoint.description: Engine API endpoint of the validator's execution-layer node.

payload-validator.engine-api-endpoint.en.description: Engine API endpoint URL of the execution-layer node.

payload-validator.engine-api-endpoint.jw.description: Optional path to the JWT secret file used for authenticated Engine API calls. Omit to disable JWT authentication.

payload-validator.engine-api-endpoint.ti.description: Overall timeout for a single request to this endpoint.

payload-validator.payload-validation-ena.description: Whether to validate execution payloads received via the Engine API. Must stay true when the qbft section is set: a validator fails to start with payload validation disabled. Only followers may set it to false.

persistence.data-path.description: Directory where Maru stores its persistent on-disk state (database, keystore).

persistence.private-key-path.description: Path to the node private key file. Defaults to a 'private-key' file under data-path.

qbft.description: QBFT consensus settings. Omit on follower (non-validator) nodes.

qbft.duplicate-message-limit.description: Maximum number of duplicate QBFT messages kept per round.

qbft.fee-recipient.description: Fee recipient address for blocks proposed by this validator (20-byte hex).

qbft.future-message-max-distance.description: Maximum number of blocks a future-dated QBFT message may be ahead of the current height.

qbft.future-messages-limit.description: Maximum number of future-dated QBFT messages queued.

qbft.message-queue-limit.description: Maximum number of QBFT messages queued per round.

qbft.min-block-build-time.description: Minimum time spent building a block before proposing it.

qbft.round-expiry.description: Optional fixed expiry duration for a QBFT round. Omit to derive it from round-expiry-coefficient.

qbft.round-expiry-coefficient.description: Multiplier used to derive each subsequent round's expiry from the previous one.

syncing.description: Sync settings used while catching up to the chain head.

syncing.desync-tolerance.description: How far the sync target may be ahead of this node's head before the node is considered desynced.

syncing.download.description: Block download settings used while syncing.

syncing.download.block-range-request-tim.description: Timeout for a single block-range download request.

syncing.download.blocks-batch-size.description: Number of blocks requested in a single download batch.

syncing.download.blocks-parallelism.description: Number of block-range download requests issued in parallel.

syncing.download.max-retries.description: Maximum number of retries for a failed download request.

syncing.download.use-unconditional-rando.description: Whether to pick a random download peer unconditionally on each request.

syncing.el-sync-status-refresh-interval.description: Optional interval to refresh the execution-layer sync status. Omit to disable.

syncing.peer-chain-height-polling-interv.description: Interval between polls for peer chain height updates.

syncing.sync-target-selection.description: Sync target selection strategy. Use a bare string 'Highest' to sync to the highest peer head, or an inline table { _type = 'MostFrequent', peer-chain-height-granularity = <n> } to sync to the most frequent peer chain height. Sealed-type dispatch is enabled by the loader.
